rationale.intuition: Juilliard 录取 ~8.6% (instrumental violin pre-college pipeline ~5-15%) 完全基于 audition + repertoire + faculty fit; SAT/GPA 几乎不参与决策。Strong pre-college pipeline + YoungArts Finalist 是 industry-recognized signal of audition-readiness. Engine 当前会触发 audition_or_portfolio_admission 分支返回 probability=0 + insufficientData (anchor=0, tier=4)。这个 fixture 故意 expose engine 在 audition-first 学校的 sentinel 行为 — 锚定 industry consensus 范围而非 engine output, 标 wontFix 让其报告 actual 但不 block CI。

sources.name: Juilliard Admissions Statistics 2024
sources.evidence: Pre-college dance/drama/music overall admit ~8.6% — entirely audition-driven; admissions FAQ explicitly states SAT/GPA are reviewed only for academic eligibility, not weighted vs audition

sources.name: NACAC Conservatory Admissions Whitepaper 2023
sources.evidence: Audition-first institutions: academic credentials function as eligibility threshold (typically B average / no minimum SAT), faculty audition score is 80-90% of decision weight

sources.name: Counselor Engine isAuditionOrPortfolioSchool
sources.evidence: Engine detects institutionType=MUSIC_CONSERVATORY and returns probability=0 with insufficientData reason — sentinel behavior; this fixture documents the gap between engine declining to predict and industry's realistic 5-25% range for pipeline-strong applicants

wontFix.reason: Engine intentionally declines to predict for audition-first schools (anchor=0, tier=4, insufficientData). Industry has a real probability band but engine math cannot estimate it from academic stats alone. Fixture documents this gap.
wontFix.followUp: Possible future work: incorporate portfolio/audition strength signal (e.g. competition tier, pre-college affiliation) as an explicit anchor source for conservatories.
